'''Pendlestat''' was a business located on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. It hired out experts in a variety of fields, except for athletics and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Some of the experts were [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and some exchanged their services for passage aboard the liner. The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] occasionally embedded operatives in Pendlestat posing as experts.
